sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can wish for something using szeretném, ha and bárcsak + conditional.
I can say what I want to happen using hogy + -jon/-jen after verbs like akar and szeretné.
I can explain the purpose of an action, and how to prevent something, using azért, hogy and nehogy.
I can use the full set of plans, wishes, obstacles and goals vocabulary from this unit.
